summary.content:
Today's selection covers 46 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 28 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Hackers abuse Google ads, Claude.ai chats to push Mac malware
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Over 500 Organizations Hit in Years-Long Phishing Campaign
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 7 articles published in the last 24 hours
